meta.name: industry-key-contact-radar-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users discover key contacts across industries, roles, and social platforms via the BrowserAct API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like finding public profiles for founders or CEOs, discovering key decision-makers in a specific industry, extracting contact details for lead generation, searching for growth leaders on LinkedIn or Facebook, gathering professional networking profiles, retrieving URLs and names of industry leaders, finding marketing managers in a specific field, conducting competitive analysis by identifying key personnel, sourcing talent acquisition targets across platforms, or compiling a list of target roles on specific social sites.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现各行业关键联系人，用于销售线索挖掘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从社交平台批量获取行业决策者联系方式
copy.tagline_en: Discover key contacts across industries for lead generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find decision-makers' contact details from social platforms

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你指定的行业、职位、平台和数量，自动搜索并返回目标人物的公开主页链接、姓名、简介和公司信息。
howto.when: 当你需要查找特定行业或职位的关键联系人，比如创始人、CEO、市场经理等，并希望从 LinkedIn、Facebook 等平台获取公开资料时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下电商行业的创始人，从 LinkedIn 上找10个。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 在 Facebook 上找医疗行业的市场经理。
say.note: Claude 会按参数执行搜索。

say.text: 搜索 GitHub 上浏览器自动化领域的开发者，职位不限。
say.note: Claude 会使用默认职位或你指定的职位。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search for and return public profile URLs, names, introductions, and company info of target contacts based on your specified industry, job title, platform, and result limit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find key contacts in a specific industry or role, such as founders, CEOs, marketing managers, etc., and want public profiles from platforms like LinkedIn or Facebook.

say_en.text: Find 10 founders in the e-commerce industry on LinkedIn.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the skill and return results.

say_en.text: Find marketing managers in healthcare on Facebook.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the search with given parameters.

say_en.text: Search for developers in browser automation on GitHub, any job title.
say_en.note: Claude will use default job title or yours.
